input.title: Give the password field the accessible name "Password"
input.rationale: The password input (#su-pass) has no accessible name. A visible <label>Password</label> sits right before it on line 11, but that label has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the input, so it isn't linked to the field. I can only edit this input, so this patch sets aria-label="Password" on it. That matches the visible label, so screen reader users and voice control users get the same name sighted users see. A cleaner fix in the source would be to add for="su-pass" to the label on line 11. Then clicking the label would also put focus in the field. If you make that change, you can drop the aria-label.
